content: {"hypothesis": "The LLMNR multicast queries to 224.0.0.252:5355 and ff02::1:3 come from the Windows DNS client in svchost.exe and look like normal name-resolution fallback alongside routine DHCP, NTP and KMS traffic, so this is likely benign; the cheapest useful check is to confirm osppsvc.exe, the one notable contact (KMS port 1688), is the legitimate Office licensing service.", "attack_likelihood": 0.08, "choice": 0}
